thesis: The page is an open ledger: every section is a cost-sheet line item with a percent-of-budget column on the right edge, and the running total in the margin climbs to 100% by the footer.

signature.name: Ledger line + percent column
signature.summary: A thin ruled line separates each section like a row on a cost sheet; a vertical percent column on the right edge shows that section's share of budget; a running total accumulates to 100% at the footer.

palette.family: Ledger cream + ink blue + signal red

motion.intro: Ledger lines rule themselves across the right half (800ms), then figures type in one by one with a soft tick (stagger 60ms). Skippable; text readable at 0ms with reduced motion.
stories: count: running total accumulates as sections enter viewport
draw: budget split bar chart draws segment by segment on input
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX(0→1), 200ms, --ease-out
